description: This PHP source file defines the PredefinedChart class, which contains methods for generating SQL queries related to various predefined charts in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for charting sales pipeline stages, lead sources, outcomes by month, lead sources by outcome, and module usage, as well as a method for loading custom chart queries.

classes.name: PredefinedChart
classes.description: Class that defines methods to generate SQL queries for different predefined charts in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: predefinedChartQuery
methods.description: Dispatches to specific chart query methods based on the chart type.

methods.name: pipelineBySalesStageQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for pipeline by sales stage chart, considering user preferences and date ranges.

methods.name: leadSourceByOutcomeQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for lead source by outcome chart, considering filters and user preferences.

methods.name: outcomeByMonthQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for outcomes over months, considering user date preferences.

methods.name: pipelineByLeadSourceQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL for pipeline by lead source chart, considering filters and user preferences.

methods.name: myModuleUsageLast30Days
methods.description: Generates SQL to track module usage over the last 30 days.

methods.name: customChartQuery
methods.description: Loads custom chart query from a PHP file in the custom directory if it exists.
